author: CC
prose: The librarian launcher starts the ground loop with `python3 -m cairn.devices.ground_loop` (cairn/devices/librarian/0/bin/librarian lines 92, 97, 105), a module that no longer resolves — importlib.util.find_spec('cairn.devices.ground_loop') returned None on 2026-09-24; the loop moved to cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop (bin/cmd/groundloop execs cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.cli). Every start path ends in `|| true` with stderr to the log, so when no loop is live the librarian's _ensure_loop fails silently. It should start the loop through the one path the other launchers use, and fail loud when it cannot.
